# The303 Creative

> The303 Creative is a marketing, web design and commercial photography studio in Miami, FL, led by founder Maikel Marshall. We help service businesses and brands turn attention into qualified inquiries and bookings — combining content, websites, local SEO and AI assistants. Work is delivered in English and Spanish (EN/ES).

## What we do
- Marketing for Miami businesses: strategy, local SEO, web design, content and paid media, built to generate qualified inquiries.
- Web design: mobile-first websites built around one clear offer, with booking and analytics; the client owns all accounts.
- Local SEO: Google Business Profile, local pages, reviews and citations so nearby customers find and choose the business.
- Content creation: photo and video shot in batches, planned by channel, delivered ready to post.
- Commercial photography: brand portraits, corporate headshots, product, food, fashion and events.
- Branding and AI assistants (chat + lead follow-up automation).
